tagline.en_US: Ombi allows you to host your own Plex Request and user management system.

description.en_US: Ombi is a media request and user management system designed for Plex servers. It allows shared users to request movies and TV shows through a dedicated interface. Administrators can manage incoming requests, communicate notes to users, and track reported media issues. The system can also automatically send weekly newsletters highlighting newly added content.
